title: TutorCaseBench: A Case-Grounded Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Tutors in Supporting Students with Challenging Behaviors
abstract: arXiv:2610.30828v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLMs are increasingly used as AI tutors, yet existing benchmarks overlook the challenging behaviors common among students with learning and behavioral difficulties. We introduce TutorCaseBench, a benchmark that grounds AI-tutor evaluation in qualitative case studies from pedagogy, educational psychology, and special education. Our pipeline converts documented student categories into case-specific scenarios, tutor-student dialogues, and rubrics grounded in source evidence. The benchmark contains 923 dialogues across five challenge types, evaluated through open-ended response generation (1,560 items) and multiple-choice selection (2,537 items). Across 11 state-of-the-art LLMs, even the strongest model satisfies a rubric criterion in only 55.8% of open-ended cases, while models are better at selecting appropriate strategies than generating situated responses. translated_title: TutorCaseBench：一个基于案例的基准，用于评估LLM导师在支持具有挑战性行为的学生方面的表现
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型越来越多地被用作AI导师，然而现有的基准测试忽视了在学习和行为困难学生中常见的挑战性行为。我们介绍了TutorCaseBench，这是一个将AI导师评估建立在来自教育学、教育心理学和特殊教育的定性案例研究基础之上的基准。我们的流程将记录在案的学生类别转化为基于源证据的特定案例场景、师生对话和评分标准。该基准包含923段对话，涵盖五种挑战类型，通过开放式回复生成（1,560个题目）和多项选择（2,537个题目）进行评估。在11个最先进的大型语言模型中，即使是最强的模型，在开放式案例中也仅有55.8%的情况满足评分标准，且模型在选择恰当策略方面比生成情境化回复的表现更好。这些结果揭示了干预识别能力与情境特定应用能力之间的差距。
tldr: 提出了TutorCaseBench基准，基于教育学、教育心理学和特殊教育的真实案例评估LLM导师应对学生挑战性行为的能力，发现即使是最强的模型在开放式案例中也仅满足55.8%的评分标准，且模型识别恰当干预策略的能力优于生成情境化回复的能力。
en_tdlr: TutorCaseBench, a benchmark grounded in qualitative case studies from pedagogy, educational psychology, and special education, evaluates LLM tutors in supporting students with challenging behaviors, revealing that even the strongest models satisfy only 55.8% of rubric criteria in open-ended cases and are better at recognizing appropriate strategies than generating context-specific situated responses.
